CRIMINAL REVISION APPLICATION (AGAINST CONVICTION - FOOD  ADULTRATION ACT) NO. 657 of 2014 FOR APPROVAL AND SIGNATURE:
HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE N.V.ANJARIA ===========================================================
1 Whether Reporters of Local Papers may be allowed No  to see the judgment ?
2 To be referred to the Reporter or not ?
No 3 Whether their Lordships wish to see the fair copy of No  the judgment ?
4 Whether this case involves a substantial question of No  law as to the interpretation of the Constitution of  India or any order made thereunder ?

=
 STATE OF GUJARAT - THRO' S.M.RAO, FOOD INSPECTOR....Applicant(s)
 Versus  SUNILKUMAR DIPCHAND SONKAR....Respondent(s)
================================================================
Appearance:
MR KP RAVAL, APP for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR RAJESH M CHAUHAN, ADVOCATE for the Respondent(s) No. 1 =============================================================

== =
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE N.V.ANJARIA  Date : 20/04/2015  ORAL JUDGMENT

The State has filed this Revision Application against order dated 12.07.2014 passed by  l e a r n e d J u d i c i a l M a g i s t r a t e ( F i r s t C l a s s ) a t T a r a p u r , i n  State Of Gujarat - Thro' S.M.Rao vs Sunilkumar Dipchand Sonkar on 20 April, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181324450/
1
Criminal Case No. 1940 of 2008, whereby the complaint was ordered to be dismissed.
The  dismissal of the complaint was on the ground that the complainant was R/CR.RA/657/2014 JUDGMENT not present and that therefore, he was found to be not interested.
2 . H e a r d l e a r n e d A d d i t i o n a l P u b l i c P r o s e c u t o r  Mr. K. P. Raval for the applicant and learned advocate Mr. Rajesh M. Chauhan for the respondent.

3 . I t a p p e a r s t h a t t h e c o m p l a i n a n t F o o d I n s p e c t o r  filed complaint under the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 before  the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate (First Class) at Khambhat.

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate (First Class) at Khambhat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It further appears that the  said Criminal Case registered came to be transferred on 18.07.2013 to the  Court of learned Judicial Magistrate (First Class) at Tarapur.
4 . L e a r n e d A P P p u r s u a n t t o o r d e r d a t e d 0 6 .
0 4 . 2 0 1 5  passed in the present proceedings, produced certified copy of the Rojkam relating to the  proceedings that took place before the Khambhat Court.

From the Rojkam, 
i t c o u l d b e s e e n t h a t t h e c o m p l a i n a n t w a s p r e s e n t o n a  particular day, that is, on 20.03.2010.

The order of learned Judicial Magistrate(First Class) at  T a r a p u r , t h e r e f o r e , d i s m i s s i n g t h e c o m p l a i n t o n t h e g r o u n d t h a t  the complainant was not present and that therefore, he was not interested, is manifestly  e r r o n e o u s a n d a g a i n s t t h e r e c o r d . I t a p p e a r s t h a t l e a r n e d J u d i c i a l  M a g i s t r a t e ( F i r s t C l a s s ) a t T a r a p u r d i d n o t v e r i f y t h e  details of the proceedings before the Khambhat Court which fortified the presence of the  complainant.

It was further noticed that the criminal case in question was a warrant triable  c a s e , t h e r e f o r e a c c u s e d ' s R / C R . R A / 6 5 7 / 2 0 1 4 J U D G M E N T p r e s e n c e w a s a l s o n e c e s s a r y . H o w e v e r , i t w a s o b s e r v e d  in the impugned order that the summons was sent to the accused which had remained  unserved.
Despite the aforesaid, though service of summons was necessary and  accused's presence was required to be secured, learned Magistrate dismissed the complaint on  the aforesaid count.
5. Learned advocate for the respondent tried to contend that long years time has passed  in between.
Such a contention could not be countenanced when the aforesaid aspect is clearly  emerging factually falsifying the ground on which the impugned order is rested.
6 . F o r t h e r e a s o n s a n d d i s c u s s i o n a f o r e s a i d , t h e  impugned order cannot sustain.
The same is hereby set aside.
Revision Application is allowed.
Rule is made absolute.

7. While parting, it is observed that the complainant who is present in the Court, 
assures through his advocate that he will appear before the Court as and when required  and cooperate in the proceedings of the Criminal Case.
It is hoped that the Trial Court shall  complete the exercise as expeditiously as possible in view of the same being old one.
